request: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

actions.operation: Create a rectangular pocket/cut (opening) on the lower back face of the coffee machine body
actions.target: Lower back exterior area on the rear of the enclosure, implemented as an access opening through the rear vent/grille panel and a matching recessed pocket into the main housing behind it
actions.relational_constraint: Use the rear face as the reference. Locate the opening in the lower-back region and constrain it to be horizontally centered (equidistant to left and right side edges). Vertically, place it so the distance from the opening’s bottom edge to the device bottom edge is approximately equal to the left/right side margins (i.e., bottom margin approximately equals side margin). Corners rounded with R10 mm. Cut direction normal to the rear face (into the machine).
actions.unresolved_reference: Confirm whether the rear vent/grille panel (S3) is intended to have a through opening (recommended for plug/switch access) with the 30 mm depth formed by a pocket in the main housing behind, versus attempting to form a 30 mm deep pocket only in the grille panel (likely too thin). Confirm the opening should be centered to the overall device width (S1 sidewalls) or centered to the rear panel frame (S3 perimeter).
steps: Set active components/bodies for editing: Rear vent/grille panel (Section S3) and Main outer housing/U-frame shell (Section S1).
Define rear reference face for sketching: select S3 major face_code 0029 (Grille outer face plane). This is the visible rear exterior face in the multiview images.

Create robust centering references: (a) create/activate a vertical construction center plane at the mid-width of the device using the main housing outer side walls S1 face_code 0002 (left outer side wall) and S1 face_code 0000 (right outer side wall) as symmetric references; (b) alternatively (or additionally) create a sketch centerline by projecting S3 perimeter edges using S3 left perimeter edge plane face_code 0027 and S3 right perimeter edge plane face_code 0023 and constraining the centerline to be equidistant to them.

On S3 face_code 0029, start a 2D sketch. Draw a center-point rounded rectangle (or rectangle + sketch fillets) with overall size 200 mm (width, left-right) x 100 mm (height, up-down). Apply corner radius = 10 mm to all four corners.

Apply sketch constraints for location: constrain the rounded-rectangle center point coincident with the device mid-width reference (construction plane intersection / sketch centerline) so it is equally distanced from left and right sides. For vertical placement in the lower-back region: project the rear panel bottom reference using S3 bottom perimeter edge plane face_code 0028 (and/or project a line derived from S1 bottom datum plane face_code 0004). Dimension the distance from the rounded-rectangle bottom edge to the projected bottom edge line. Set this bottom margin to be approximately equal to the side margin value (side margin = (overall rear panel/device width − 200 mm) / 2). If the CAD system supports an equality constraint, constrain the bottom margin dimension equal to the side margin dimension; otherwise, drive the bottom margin with the computed value.

Create the opening through the rear vent/grille panel (S3): perform an Extrude Cut using the sketch profile, direction inward normal to face_code 0029. Set extent to Through All for S3 only (this yields a true exterior opening suitable for plug/switch access).

Create the 30 mm deep recessed pocket into the main housing behind the rear panel (S1): reuse the same sketch (or create a derived sketch by projecting the cut boundary onto S1 rear boundary face_code 0003). Perform an Extrude Cut on S1, direction inward, blind depth = 30 mm. This establishes the requested '3 cm deep' recess volume behind the rear opening.

Corner treatment confirmation: the profile already contains R10 mm corners; no additional edge fillets are required. If manufacturing/aesthetics require edge softening, optionally add a small edge fillet (e.g., R1–R2 mm) to the rear opening rim on the cut edges, but only if allowed by design intent (not explicitly requested).

Validate clearances and intent: verify the opening remains in the lower-back region without intersecting the base feet (S5) or major internal supports, and that the opening is centered relative to the device sidewalls and not too close to the bottom datum plane. Confirm the recess does not break through unintended internal faces.

intention: Provide a draft location/opening for a power plug connection and the main ON/OFF switch on the back of the coffee machine.
